title: detection.json
description: One entry per detector, the rules first, then each model as the thresholds record it. Each holds what it caught at each `hold`, keyed by the `hold`.

false_positive_rate.description: The share of moving rows with no attack that the model's score alone flags. Read it against `TARGET`.

threshold.description: The score above which the model flags a row.

false_positive_rate.description: The share of moving rows with no attack that the model's score alone flags. Read it against `TARGET`.

hold.description: What the detector caught at one `hold`.

found.description: Attacks caught, of all the attacks injected.

caught.description: Which attacks were caught, numbered as `attacks.json` lists them.

found_worth_catching.description: The same over the attacks that reach a row above `min_speed` and moved it by at least `moved`.
